column2: [intro]
I’ve got a library overflowing, full of books to explore,
But in my reading, I just can’t commit anymore.
I start a book with passion, all fired up inside,
But after a few pages, my enthusiasm subsides.
I can’t finish the books, it’s my reality,
The characters drown in endless obscurity.
I can’t finish the books, oh what a fate,
Leave me be with this burden, it's my own weight.
I always promise myself I'll complete them someday,
But between the pages, my interest just drifts away.
Distracted by screens and technology’s spree,
The books lie abandoned, gathering dust silently.
I can’t finish the books, it’s my reality,
The words get lost in an unfinished melody.
I can’t finish the books, oh what a fate,
Leave me be with this incapacity, it’s my state.
[ solo ]
I can’t finish the books, it’s my reality,
But in my songs, I’m a star of creativity.
I can’t finish the books, oh what a fate,
Leave me be with my unique trait.
[outro]
